import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import MultiOutputClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define columns
label_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Prepare features
X_text = train_df["comment_text"].fillna(" ").values
y = train_df[label_cols].values

# Split for validation (hold-out set)
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_text,
    y,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y[:, 0],  # stratify on toxic label
)

# TF-IDF vectorization with word and char ngrams
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english",
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000,
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    analyzer="char",
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit on training data only
X_train_word = tfidf_word.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_train_char = tfidf_char.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_train = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])

X_val_word = tfidf_word.transform(X_val_text)
X_val_char = tfidf_char.transform(X_val_text)
X_val = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

X_test_word = tfidf_word.transform(test_df["comment_text"].fillna(" "))
X_test_char = tfidf_char.transform(test_df["comment_text"].fillna(" "))
X_test = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Train MultiOutput Logistic Regression with elasticnet
# Use saga solver with elasticnet penalty for sparse matrices
base_model = LogisticRegression(
    C=0.5,
    l1_ratio=0.5,
    penalty="elasticnet",
    solver="saga",
    max_iter=1000,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

model = MultiOutputClassifier(base_model, n_jobs=-1)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validation predictions
val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_preds = np.column_stack([proba[:, 1] for proba in val_proba])

# Compute column-wise ROC AUC on validation set
roc_auc_scores = []
for i, col in enumerate(label_cols):
    if y_val[:, i].sum() > 0:  # Only compute if there are positive samples
        score = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[:, i])
        roc_auc_scores.append(score)

mean_auc = np.mean(roc_auc_scores)
print(f"Validation Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Test predictions
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)
test_preds = np.column_stack([proba[:, 1] for proba in test_proba])

# Prepare submission
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
for i, col in enumerate(label_cols):
    submission_df[col] = test_preds[:, i]

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
